metadata.metaDescription: Architects Atelier, founded in 2004 by Ar. Mamta Saini and Ar. Gaurav Saini, is a Greater Noida-based architectural and design firm committed to enhancing quality of life through thoughtful, human-centric design solutions. We re the Best Architects In Greater Noida.

aboutSection.title: About Architects Atelier
aboutSection.description: Ar. Gaurav Saini, co-founder and partner of ARCHITECTS ATELIER , has been practicing in Greater Noida since 2005, alongside Ar. Mamta Saini. With a Bachelor's degree from GCA, Lucknow, U.P., a Master's in Ekistics from Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi, and a second Master's in Town & Country Planning from the Institute of Town Planners India, New Delhi. ARCHITECTS ATELIER deals with various project types including Healthcare, Institutional, Commercial, Hospitality, and High-End Residential projects.
